content: Three.js r155 (released mid-2024) is the latest stable as of 2025-2026. Three.js r155 integrates with React via react-three-fiber (r8+), which provides React hooks and components for 3D. The trio stack (three, react-three-fiber, three-mesh-raycaster) is the standard. For educational atomic structure visualizations, Three.js with GLTFLoader enables importing detailed atom models. WebGL2 is required. r155 dropped old RGBE loader in favor of RGBELoader separate package.
